WITH budget_with_event AS (
  SELECT 
    b.spent,
    b.amount,
    e.event_id,
    e.type
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    type,
    AVG(CASE WHEN amount = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE spent / CAST(amount AS REAL) END) AS event_rate
  FROM budget_with_event
  GROUP BY event_id, type
),
type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    type,
    AVG(event_rate) AS type_avg_rate
  FROM event_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM type_rates
)
SELECT 
  t.type,
  t.type_avg_rate,
  t.type_avg_rate / o.mean_rate
FROM type_rates t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
